messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of miscarriage"
set: ["hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of miscarriage", "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of high blood pressure in pregnancy", "may increase risk of unintended pregnancy", "may increase risk of eclampsia", "risk of depression if discontinued during pregnancy", "may increase risk of neural tube defects in early pregnancy", "may increase risk of muscle problems", "may cause complications during pregnancy", "during pregnancy", "may increase risk of low birth weight", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "alcohol may increase risk of liver damage", "increased risk of complications in newborns during late pregnancy", "miscarriage", "higher during pregnancy", "may increase risk of severe bleeding after childbirth"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
